title: 난이도 6-6 선택 & People 질문 전략 | 오픽노잼 026
summary: 난이도는 항상 6-6(최고) 선택 — '난이도'는 내 실력이 아니라 고점수를 받을 수 있는 확률. 낮게 고르면 어려운 질문이 안 나와서 AL 불가능
중간에 재조정 질문이 나오면 '똑같이(same)'로 유지 — 내려가는 순간 확률 감소
People 질문 전략 변화: 예전엔 나(P1)로 컨트롤하면 됐지만, 요즘 채점자들이 까다로워져서 다른 사람 감정까지 보여줘야 AL 가능
AL 학생 차이: 나의 감정만이 아니라 친구·가족 등 주변 사람의 감정도 묘사 — 'My friend didn't enjoy it as much as I did'

keyExpressions.en: Difficulty level is not your ability — it's your probability of getting a high score.
keyExpressions.ko: 난이도는 내 실력이 아니라 고점수 확률이다

keyExpressions.en: My friend didn't enjoy it as much as I did.
keyExpressions.note: 다른 사람의 감정 묘사 — AL 차별화 포인트

keyExpressions.en: I could tell she was a little disappointed.
For me it was amazing, but for her it was just okay.
keyExpressions.ko: 나에겐 놀라웠지만, 그녀에겐 그냥 괜찮은 정도였다
keyExpressions.note: 나 vs 타인 감정 대조 — AL 표현

keyExpressions.en: I think what made it special was not just the place itself, but the people I was with.
keyExpressions.ko: 특별했던 건 장소 자체뿐 아니라 함께한 사람들이었다

cards.back: Always choose 6-6 (hardest). Difficulty = probability of a high score, not your ability.
cards.example: 사사(4-4)를 고르면 외국인도 AL 불가능. 항상 6-6 선택.

cards.front: 친구는 나만큼 즐기지 않았다 (AL 타인 감정 묘사)
cards.back: My friend didn't enjoy it as much as I did.
cards.example: I loved the food, but my friend didn't enjoy it as much as I did — she said it was too spicy.

cards.back: I could tell she was a little disappointed.
cards.example: I could tell she was a little disappointed, which made me feel bad.

cards.front: 나에겐 놀라웠지만, 그녀에겐 그냥 괜찮은 정도
cards.back: For me it was amazing, but for her it was just okay.
cards.example: AL 차별화: 나 혼자의 감정이 아닌 다른 사람의 감정까지 대조해서 보여주기
